assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: complete background ground map for an original Chinese wuxia 2D pixel RPG, landscape 1536 by 1024. Primary request: a richly detailed wilderness forest floor viewed from fixed oblique 45-degree overhead camera, isometric game map, no horizon and no sky. Composition: entire image is traversable ground, mossy deep green forest earth with an ancient warm ochre dirt road about 140 pixels wide winding diagonally from bottom left (x220 y1024) through (x500 y650) then (x800 y500) to upper right (x1380 y140), a second fork branches from the middle toward upper left (x100 y240). A broad open circular clearing at x800 y500, a few broken ancient stone paving slabs along the road, grass and ferns, tiny blue and white wildflowers, exposed roots, scattered pebbles and fallen golden leaves. A small luminous teal woodland spring, oval in perspective, near x300 y280, ringed with mossy rocks; small ruined stone lantern near x1230 y220 beside path. Frame the far edges with low bushes and rocks, but do NOT paint any tall trees, canopy, large foreground objects or tree trunks: tall trees will be separate runtime sprites for correct occlusion. Dappled sunlight from upper left, jade, olive and muted moss colors, warm amber path, detailed hand placed crisp pixel clusters in classic polished late-1990s Chinese RPG painted pixel-art style. Ground plane recedes diagonally, 2:1 diamond perspective for stones and water. Flat game map asset that completely fills the image, no UI, labels, text, people, animals, grid, borders, transparency or visible sky. Intricate organic texture, cohesive pixel shading, avoid smooth digital airbrush or chunky low-detail vectors.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent environment sprite atlas for an original Chinese wuxia isometric pixel RPG. A 1536 by 1024 transparent canvas divided into exactly THREE columns and TWO rows of equal 512 by 512 cells, no visible grid. Six independent sprites, one fully contained in each cell with generous 24px clear margin. Top row left: majestic mature twisting Chinese pine tree with umbrella canopy, dense detailed olive jade needles, branching brown trunk and exposed roots; top middle: rounded mature broadleaf forest tree with lush jade green canopy, gnarled ochre trunk and roots; top right: slender cluster of tall bamboo with fine leaves. Bottom row left: smaller golden green deciduous tree with slightly asymmetric airy canopy; bottom middle: low grouping of mossy slate boulders with ferns; bottom right: ancient weathered stone roadside lantern with moss on pagoda cap. Every sprite viewed from the SAME fixed 45 degree overhead 2:1 isometric perspective, entire tree including roots visible without cropping, roots/foot ground contact centered horizontally at 50 percent of cell width and at 90 percent of cell height, sprites not touching. No ground tiles, no base diamond, actual transparent background. Polished late 1990s painted pixel art Chinese fantasy RPG style with finely articulated crisp pixel clusters and complex light/shadow, intricate needles and leaves, warm sunlight upper left, shadows cool blue green. Usable game sprites, no people, text, labels, border, checkerboard pattern, smooth vector shapes, blurry edges or photorealism. Large full tree canopy fills upper cell width but leaves clear margin. Keep all six cells strictly equal.
